== English errata source comparison ==
The November 1998 entry strikes through hologram in lore and supplies replacement game text. Both changes belong to the Decipher state; the January 2002 Supplement repeats them. The added documentary state has no allocated gameplay ID and no substituted card image. The current identifier remains on the later PC damage-segment rewrite.
